title: Converting a Boolean function back
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Converting $f$ to a function on the binary cube and then transporting it back to the sign cube recovers $f$ exactly.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
